newsitem.title: USA: AT&T Corp Q4 oper net rises.
newsitem.headline: AT&T Corp Q4 oper net rises.

text.p: NOTE: Net income is from continuing operations before restructuring and other charges.
1995 Q4 oper net excludes restructuring and other charges of $2.036 billion, or $1.27 per share. Including these charges, net from continuing operations was a loss of $948 million, or $0.59 a share.
1995 Q4 oper net also excludes loss of $1.08 a share from discontinued operations. Including this loss, and including the above restructuring and other charges, net loss was $1.67 a share.

1996 Q4 oper net excludes gain of $0.14 a share from income from discontinued operations, and gain of $0.10 a share from the sale of discontinued operations. Including these gains, net income was $1.00 a share.
First Call consensus estimate for Q4 was $0.79 a share.
